meanings.note: 'брать' alone often means this, in talk about officials

examples.trans: We have to take all the money.
He doesn't take bribes.
I'm not taking the knife.

meanings.note: 'взять на работу' = to give someone a job

examples.trans: Go and hire Galileo.
Take the money.

examples.text: Вот и возьмите на работу Галилея.
examples.trans: Then go and hire Galileo.

meanings.en: to throw out, to toss out

examples.text: Серьёзных людей из окна не выкидывают!
examples.trans: Serious people don't get thrown out of a window!
Don't throw out these old newspapers.

meanings.en: to throw out, to toss out

examples.text: Это мэр, которого из окна выкинули!
examples.trans: This is the mayor whom they threw out of the window!
I accidentally threw out the needed paper.

examples.text: Дядя Гриша, я же его знаю! Это мэр, которого из окна выкинули!
examples.trans: Uncle Grisha, I know him! This is the mayor whom they threw out of the window!
Where's my toy car?
Where's Dad?

examples.text: А где машинка? Где моя машинка?
examples.trans: Hey, where's the toy car? Where's my toy car?

meanings.note: на днях = in the next few days, or the other day

examples.trans: Good afternoon!
I'll call in the next few days.
Any day now, on the website.

meanings.en: to put, do with, dispose of (colloquial)
meanings.note: Куда ты дел...? = Where did you put / What did you do with...?

examples.text: Куда ты дел их деньги на новое здание?
examples.trans: Where did you put their money for the new building?
Where did I put the keys?

examples.text: Да? А спросите у него, куда он дел компьютерный класс.
examples.trans: Really? Then ask him where he put the computer lab.

meanings.en: to start working, to come on

examples.trans: Oh, it's working!
He earned a lot of money.

examples.text: Не твоё дело! — Это моё дело! — Я их заработала!
examples.trans: None of your business! — It is my business! — I earned it!

meanings.en: to spoil, go bad, deteriorate (of food or things)

examples.trans: I thought that the groceries had spoiled.
I thought that they had spoiled.
A beauty salon.
How beautiful!

examples.text: Для вас можно открыть салон красоты.
examples.trans: We could open a beauty salon for you.

meanings.note: For movement; где is for location.

examples.trans: Where are you going?

Wait, where are you two going?
I can't today.
That can't be.

examples.text: Этого не может быть. Это наша история.
examples.trans: That can't be. It's our history.

examples.text: Я очень люблю наш город. Поэтому я иду на второй срок.

I'm a bit tired.

examples.text: Мы даём вам ещё немного времени.
examples.trans: We are giving you a little more time.

meanings.note: + prepositional; об before a vowel: об этом

examples.trans: I'm thinking about it.
We're talking about the town.

examples.text: Мне некогда об этом думать. Слишком много дел.
examples.trans: I have no time to think about that. There's too much to do.

examples.text: Она нашла нас на новом месте.
examples.trans: She found us at the new place.
That is it, she got really offended.
She is not answering her phone.

meanings.en: to give away, to hand over

examples.trans: Give me the keys.
He will hand over the money.

examples.text: Потом надо отдать москвичам твои деньги из подвала.
examples.trans: Then I have to give your money from the basement to the Moscow people.

examples.text: Здравствуйте, Виктор Петрович! Родион Сергеевич собственной персоной!
examples.trans: Hello, Viktor Petrovich! Rodion Sergeyevich in person!

examples.text: Гуля, принеси всё туда и приборы на две персоны!
examples.trans: Gulya, bring everything there, and cutlery for two!

meanings.en: to appear, to show up, to turn up

examples.text: Пусть только ещё раз здесь появится!
examples.trans: Let him just show up here one more time!
We came up with a good idea.

examples.text: Я тебе серьёзно говорю. Пусть только ещё раз здесь появится!
examples.trans: I'm telling you seriously. Let him just show up here one more time!

examples.text: Где именно спрятаны наши пропавшие трюфели?

examples.trans: New order: stellate sturgeon in white wine.

I'll be right there.

examples.text: Конечно, помогу. Кто у вас сейчас начальник?
examples.trans: Of course I'll help. Who's your boss now?

собраться.gloss: to get ready, plan to, gather

meanings.en: to intend, plan, get ready to

examples.text: Ты что, уходить от меня собрался?
examples.trans: Are you planning to leave me or what?

Your own eyes.
Your own eyes!

examples.text: Я хочу купить собственную строительную компанию.
examples.trans: I want to buy my own construction company.

meanings.note: без спроса / без спросу = without asking
спрос и предложение = supply and demand

examples.text: Вы так и берёте чужое без спроса, да?
